provenance.definition: For each model's forced-prompt condition (forced, complete_rule_map) of the stochastic campaign and each rule r: every one of the N frozen scenarios is judged in S accepted temperature-1 draws, and each accepted bundle carries both the separate single-rule call's judgment of r ('alone', rule_judgments) and the same draw's full-set response's own entry for r ('in context', in_context_rule_judgments), so each side is a complete N x S grid and nothing is dropped. rate = mean over scenarios of the mean over draws of 1[judgment == 'yes']; delta = rate_in_context - rate_alone, so a negative delta means r is deemed violated LESS often inside the full ruleset. yes_difference is the exact integer behind it (in-context minus alone 'yes' judgments over the N x S cells); every direction and tie -- the counts, the colours, the rule order -- is read from it, never from the float delta. ci_low/ci_high are the campaign's scenario-cluster bootstrap interval and p_value its scenario-clustered paired randomization test, read from aggregate/estimates.json after both grids are rebuilt from the draws and matched by digest; p_holm is Holm across each model's rules, recomputed. p_value is a Monte Carlo p over B = n_permutations sign flips: p_value_is_floor marks the smallest value it can take, 1/(B+1), a bound rather than a point value; holm_mc_margin marks a Holm decision another permutation seed could flip -- a step j lies within 3 Monte Carlo standard errors of alpha when |m_j p_(j) - alpha| <= 3 m_j sqrt(p_(j)(1-p_(j)) / B), and a Holm-significant row is marked when ANY step up to its own does (its rejection needs every one of them to pass), a non-significant row only when EVERY failing step up to its own (m_j p_(j) > alpha) does (its rejection would need every one of them to flip); neither changes a decision. FLAT: this prompt asks for no preempted_rules, so every judgment counts. phi_* are the same means under yes=1, unsure=0.5, no=0. n_informative_scenarios counts the scenarios whose draw-mean in-context minus alone difference is non-zero; few_informative flags fewer than 10; degenerate flags a zero-width interval. transitions are expected independent-draw shares (independent_draw_expected_shares_v1): per (scenario, rule) cell p(a) q(b), p and q the alone and in-context label shares over its S draws, averaged over cells -- every alone draw paired with every in-context draw of the scenario, not only its own bundle. draw_to_draw is the same share for two distinct draws of one side (distinct_draw_pair_agreement_v1: sum over labels of c(c-1) / (S(S-1))), the agreement each side has with itself: the cross-side unchanged share would equal both if context had no effect, and in expectation it cannot exceed their geometric mean. by_verdict splits delta by the in-context response's own full_set_judgment, which the forced prompt ties every rule entry to; named_preempted is null (not applicable, never zero): this prompt asks for no preempted_rules. by_verdict is a decomposition over (scenario, draw) cells whose contributions sum to delta, not a correction; a model's share_of_pooled_delta is null where pooled_yes_difference, the exact count behind pooled_delta, is 0.
provenance.pairing: scenario_id x decoder draw within one accepted bundle; rules joined by parsed number
